cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a terrace on a castle wall overlooking the valley — seated sideways on a stool or bench; her living room with a deep sofa — holds a magnifying glass by its handle at chest height; a present-day coastal tidal bathing pool carved into pale limestone — standing on a dry step after a swim; a modern glass-walled office at dusk — holds a cup in both hands; the Changban Bridge memorial — holds a red oil-paper umbrella open over her shoulder; a present-day outdoor orchard picnic clearing on a sunny hillside — taking a first bite of a peach after a long walk; a medieval tavern — seated on a chair; a bridal room — holds a small bouquet in both hands at her waist; the inside of a quiet subway car — holds a tall iced coffee in a clear cup with a straw at chest height; a castle bathhouse with a stone pool — dries her hair with a towel; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — standing; a quiet spa lounge of robes — holds her keepsake up beside her face; the open deck of a wooden sightseeing boat on the Yangtze — kneeling on the ground
